subject: general
question: Vimal starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards North. He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, tums right and drives 19 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km, turns right, drives 13 km. He then turns left, drives 5 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: All turns are 90 degree turns only

Vimal starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards North.

He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, tums right and drives 19 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km, turns right, drives 13 km.

He then turns left, drives 5 km and stops at Point B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e42df0b62d4263960a881be444c636d761aa04c93256e7990ce01639945857c3.png] 

Thus, Vimal should drive 13 km in west direction in order to reach Point A from Point B.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
